title: OpenAI Microscope
summary: We’re introducing OpenAI Microscope, a collection of visualizations of every significant layer and neuron of eight vision “model organisms” which are often studied in interpretability. Microscope makes it easier to analyze the features that form inside these neural networks, and we hope it will help the research community as we move towards understanding these complicated systems.
body: We’re introducing OpenAI Microscope, a collection of visualizations of every significant layer and neuron of eight vision “model organisms” which are often studied in interpretability. Microscope makes it easier to analyze the features that form inside these neural networks, and we hope it will help the research community as we move towards understanding these complicated systems.
summaryZh: OpenAI推出了OpenAI Microscope，这是一个包含八个常用于可解释性研究的视觉模型中每个显著层和神经元可视化的集合。该工具旨在帮助研究人员更轻松地分析神经网络内部形成的特征，从而加深对复杂深度学习系统内部工作机制的理解。

aiReview.reasonZh: 发布了可视化视觉模型各层与神经元的工具，有助于推动模型可解释性研究。

glossary.explanationZh: 可解释性，指理解和解释机器学习模型内部决策过程及特征表示的能力
神经网络，由多层计算节点构成的深度学习基础架构
模型生物，此处指在科学研究中被广泛作为标准研究对象的典型神经网络模型
可视化，将神经网络的内部状态或特征转化为图形展示的技术手段
